full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for disposal of this rule is, in abridge, is that, the Government of the then East Pakistan allotted the house in question and leased out the property in favour of one Abdul Wahid, son of late Yasin for a period of 99 years and accordingly a lease deed was executed and registered on 11-5-1961 being deed No. 2567. After leasing out of the property in favour of said Abdul Wahid he got delivery of possession and got his name mutated in the relevant khatian and paid rents to the Government and other utility bills to different authorities. Said Abdul Wahid while in possession and enjoyment of the property died on 15-10-1967 leaving his only heir wife Jamila Khatun to inherit him. After the death of Abdul Wahid his wife Jamila Khatun obtained succession certificate from the 3rd Court of Sub-ordinate Judge, Dhaka in Succession Certificate Case No.991 of 1984. While Jamila Khatun was in possession and enjoyment of the property she transferred the same for a valuable consideration to the petitioner on 19-11-1985 by a registered deed No. 3489 and delivered possession to the petitioner. After purchase the petitioner got his name mutated in the khatian and paid all taxes and utility bills to the Government and other statutory authorities.
